summary: Full read complete; paired Console/CLI operational corrections in progress.
findings: Conventional-node workflow needs explicit Console Custom/AutoMode selection and current AL2023/version guidance.
Private endpoint access incorrectly limited to within one VPC.
Minimal VPC/subnet creation omits DNS/routing/NAT or private endpoints and does not capture/use created IDs.
Unrestricted TCP443 SG ingress is unnecessary for public API access and contradicts restricted endpoint guidance.
CreateCluster uses invalid --kubernetes-version and old1.26; add Region, correct --version and waiters.
IAM role creation can fall through to attaching policies on an existing name; node ECR policy outdated and CNI role tradeoff unqualified.
Missing explicit operator access entries; default kubeconfig/context and getnodes alone are insufficient validation.
